blurb.bm: Mulakan jejak makan anda di sekitar Chowrasta. Ini satu titik mula, bukan laluan tetap.
blurb.en: Start your own food trail around Chowrasta. One starting point, not a fixed route.

ask.bm: Cendol Pulau Pinang! Pilih 3 bahan cendol.

why.bm: Sedap! Santan, gula Melaka dan cendol hijau, atas ais serut.
why.en: Delicious! Coconut milk, palm sugar and green jelly over shaved ice.

why.bm: Betul! Chowrasta bermaksud simpang empat, merujuk kepada persimpangan jalan di situ.
why.en: Right! Chowrasta means four crossroads, after the road junction there.

intro.bm: Pasar Chowrasta di Jalan Penang ialah antara pasar paling terkenal di George Town.
intro.en: Chowrasta Market on Penang Road is one of George Town’s best-known markets.

bm: Ia diasaskan oleh masyarakat India di George Town abad ke-19.
Nama "Chowrasta" bermaksud simpang empat, merujuk kepada persimpangan jalan di sekitarnya.
en: The market was built in the 1890s.
It was established by the Indian community of 19th-century George Town.
"Chowrasta" means four crossroads, after the road junction around it.

bm: Buah pala dan jeruk pala, cenderahati Pulau Pinang
en: Nutmeg and pickled nutmeg, a Penang souvenir

fun.bm: Buah pala Pulau Pinang begitu terkenal sehingga ia sering dijual sebagai jeruk dan jus.
fun.en: Penang nutmeg is so well known that it is often sold pickled and as juice.
